result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback by capping the Termination Payment at amounts paid under Section 3.1 during the preceding three months. However, it does not specify how the payment is determined below that cap, leaving subsection (b)'s reference to an amount being “determined” without a formula. More importantly, “the sole amount payable ... in respect of termination” is broader than the permitted “sole liquidated amount” and could unintentionally eliminate accrued fees or other valid termination-related obligations. The clause should limit exclusivity to liquidated damages or early-termination charges.
